title: Death at Vornicu Manor

briefing.when: The night of November 14–15, 1926, during a storm

victim.name: Matei Vornicu
victim.description: Owner of the Vornicu lumber mill and patron of the Turda Charity Hospital. He had a heart condition and took digitalis drops every evening.

briefing.summary: Matei Vornicu died in the manor library on the night of the storm. The family doctor said “heart attack,” but the housekeeper insisted that the police be called. You are Turda Police detectives and take over the case the next morning. All four suspects slept at the manor and are now waiting at the station.
briefing.discovery: The housekeeper, Ana Mureșan, found him dead in the library armchair at 23:30. Dr. Ilie Strat pronounced him dead at 23:35 and said it was a heart attack. Ana asked for the police to be called and preserved the teacup.
coroner_report: Death occurred between 22:45 and 23:15 due to sudden cardiac arrest.
No signs of violence. No vomiting and no stomach lesions.
Teacup: a bitter residue, an unknown substance in a very high concentration. Exact identification will take three days at the Cluj laboratory.
Heart-drop bottle on the desk: normal contents and concentration.
Conclusion: probable poisoning through the tea.

story_hooks.text: Ana: “The master wrote in his journal at the desk every evening.”
Ana: “I set the cup aside in the kitchen. Nobody washed it.”
Ana: “I keep the spare room keys in the kitchen.”
The doctor locked his guest room before coming to the station.
The greenhouse belongs to Mrs. Elena and has a combination lock.

truth.motive: Dr. Strat embezzled 400,000 lei from the Charity Hospital funds to cover a 350,000-lei loan from Someșul Bank, due on November 20. Matei Vornicu had learned about it from the hospital accountant and planned to hand the file to the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday, November 17.
truth.method: Dr. Strat bought pure digitoxin and put it in a bottle identical to the victim’s heart drops, but with a black stopper. At 21:45 he switched the bottles in the library; at 22:00 the victim put ten drops into his own tea. At 23:35, alone with the body, he restored the original white-stoppered bottle.

timeline.event: Dr. Strat buys 1 g of pure digitoxin from the Black Eagle Pharmacy in Cluj.
Matei receives accountant Popescu’s letter about the 400,000 lei missing from the hospital and writes to attorney Lazăr that he will hand the file to the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday.
Ana secretly reads Matei’s letter to attorney Lazăr: it concerns the hospital money, and the master is going to the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday. She notes the departure in her calendar.
Dr. Strat arrives at the manor and is given Guest Room 2.
Matei puts 20,000 lei, the workers’ wages, in the library desk drawer.
At dinner, Dr. Strat discreetly asks Elena whether Matei has recently received letters from the hospital accountant.
Matei retires to the library. Elena says she is going upstairs to her bedroom with a migraine.
Victor and Matei argue heatedly about money in the library until 21:30.
While his uncle searches the shelves, Victor takes the 20,000 lei from the desk drawer.
Victor leaves the library, slamming the door; his uncle shouts after him. On the stairs he sees Dr. Strat heading down toward the library.
Elena leaves through the back door for the greenhouse, carrying a lamp.

Dr. Strat enters the library “to take Matei’s pulse.” Unseen, he replaces the white-stoppered heart-drop bottle with an identical black-stoppered bottle full of digitoxin. He takes the letter to attorney Lazăr from the desk.
Dr. Strat leaves the library; Ana sees him in the hall.
Ana brings the tea to the library. Matei puts ten drops from a black-stoppered bottle into it himself.
Victor arrives at the Crossroads Inn and plays cards.
Dr. Strat burns the letter to the attorney in his room’s stove; one corner remains unburned.
Elena waits in the greenhouse for a letter from the painter “R.,” who passes by the greenhouse window.
Matei sees everything with a yellow tint, feels nauseated, and his heart races; he scrawls a few words on the blotter.
Matei Vornicu dies in the library armchair.
Ana finds Matei dead and runs for the doctor.
Dr. Strat pronounces him dead and says “heart attack.” He sends Ana for a blanket and remains alone with the body for about five minutes.
Left alone, Dr. Strat restores the original white-stoppered bottle to the desk and takes the black-stoppered one.
Elena returns from the greenhouse through the back door, her boots covered in mud, and goes up to her bedroom.
Ana takes the unwashed cup to the kitchen and leaves a note telling everyone not to wash it, then goes upstairs to tell the lady of the house.
While Ana is upstairs with the lady of the house, Dr. Strat throws the pharmacy wrapper into the kitchen stove; it burns only halfway.
Victor leaves the inn and reaches the manor at about one o’clock.

suspects.name: Dr. Ilie Strat
suspects.personality: Calm, condescending, and extremely self-assured. He hides behind medical terminology and treats the detectives as people who cannot understand medicine.
suspects.speech_style: Polite and cold, with long sentences and many medical terms; he smiles smugly when contradicted.
suspects.initial_statement: After dinner I spent a few minutes with Matei. At 21:30 I went up to my room and read until Ana called me. His heart was weak; it was to be expected.
lies_about: his 21:45 visit to the library (he claims he stayed in his room reading from 21:30)
the hospital money (“the accounts are in order”)
any connection to the poison, the Cluj pharmacy, or the drop bottle

deflects_to.claim: Victor had large gambling debts and argued with his uncle about money that very evening.
The lady grows foxglove in the greenhouse, you know. It is highly toxic; digitalis is made from it.

break_stages.admits: He admits entering the library at about 21:45, but claims he only took Matei’s pulse and left five minutes later.
He admits to “some irregularities” in the hospital accounts and says he would eventually have covered them, but denies any connection to Matei’s death.

He breaks down and confesses: he bought pure digitoxin, switched the white-stoppered bottle for a black-stoppered one at 21:45, and restored the proper bottle at 23:35 so the death would look like a heart attack. Matei was going to report him on Monday.

suspects.name: Ana Mureșan
suspects.role: the manor’s housekeeper, in the household for 30 years
suspects.personality: Direct, loyal to the family, and suspicious of “city gentlemen.” She cares for the master and wants the truth uncovered, but does not readily admit her mistakes.
suspects.speech_style: Plain country speech and short sentences; she snaps when she feels accused.
suspects.initial_statement: I brought the tea at 22:00 and found him dead at 23:30. I preserved the cup.
suspects.secret: She secretly reads the master’s correspondence. From the letter to the attorney, she knew that he planned to go to the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday about something connected to the hospital.
lies_about: reading the letters (“I do not meddle in the master’s affairs”)

testimonies.fact: Between 21:15 and 21:30, she heard Mr. Victor arguing heatedly with the master about money; Victor left, slamming the door.
testimonies.trigger: what happened in the library before 21:30, or Victor and the master

testimonies.fact: At about 21:40, she saw Mrs. Elena leave through the back door toward the greenhouse with a lamp in her hand.
testimonies.trigger: Mrs. Elena that evening, or whether she saw anyone leave the house

testimonies.fact: At about 21:50, she saw Dr. Strat leaving the library and entering the hall.
testimonies.trigger: whom she saw in the hall or near the library between 21:30 and 22:00, or what the doctor did that evening

testimonies.fact: At 22:00, the master put ten drops from a black-stoppered bottle into his tea himself. She was surprised because his bottle had a white stopper.
testimonies.trigger: the heart drops, the master’s medicine, or what she saw when she brought the tea

testimonies.fact: At 23:35, the doctor sent her for a blanket and remained alone with the master for about five minutes.
testimonies.trigger: what happened after she found the body, or what the doctor did beside the master

break_stages.admits: She admits secretly reading the master’s letter to attorney Lazăr: it concerned the hospital money, and the master planned to go to the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday.

suspects.name: Victor Vornicu
suspects.personality: Charming, irritable, and accustomed to talking his way out of trouble. He jokes when cornered and quickly becomes angry when money is mentioned.
suspects.speech_style: Familiar and ironic, with jokes and quick retorts; he abruptly shifts from charm to irritation.
suspects.initial_statement: I spoke with my uncle about business, then left for the village at about 21:30. I returned after midnight.
suspects.secret: He stole 20,000 lei from his uncle’s drawer and lost 15,000 playing cards at the Crossroads Inn.
lies_about: the argument with his uncle (“it was only a business discussion”)
the money (“my uncle gave it to me”)

testimonies.fact: Leaving the library at 21:30, he saw Dr. Strat descending the stairs toward the library.
testimonies.trigger: whom he saw when leaving the library or the house at 21:30

break_stages.admits: He admits taking the 20,000 lei from the drawer and losing 15,000 at cards at the inn. He swears his uncle was alive when he left: he shouted after him.

suspects.name: Elena Vornicu
suspects.role: the victim’s wife, his second marriage
suspects.personality: Cold, elegant, and proud. She refuses to be intimidated and reveals as little as possible about her life.
suspects.speech_style: Short, polite, distant answers; she avoids details and changes the subject.
suspects.initial_statement: I had a migraine, retired at 21:00, and did not leave my bedroom.
suspects.secret: She is having an affair with the painter “R.” and planned to leave with him in December. On the night of the murder, she waited for him in the greenhouse from 21:40 until 23:40.
lies_about: where she was on the night of the murder (she claims she did not leave her bedroom)

testimonies.fact: The foxglove in the greenhouse is merely decorative; she has not touched it in months.
testimonies.trigger: the greenhouse plants or the foxglove

testimonies.fact: At dinner, Dr. Strat discreetly asked whether Matei had recently received letters from the hospital accountant.
testimonies.trigger: dinner or what she discussed with Dr. Strat

break_stages.admits: She admits staying in the greenhouse from 21:40 until 23:40, waiting for a letter from the painter “R.,” with whom she is having an affair and plans to leave in December.

clues.title: Letter from the casino
clues.player_text: In Victor’s coat pocket: a letter from the Sinaia Casino. “50,000 lei by Friday, or people will learn where you live.”
clues.proves: Victor desperately needed money.

clues.title: Inn bill
clues.player_text: In the same coat: a bill from the Crossroads Inn, November 14, 22:10–00:40. “Lost at cards: 15,000 lei.” Signed by the innkeeper.
clues.proves: Victor was at the inn at 23:35, when the bottle was restored; he had a large amount of cash that evening.

clues.title: The lady’s boots
clues.player_text: Beside the back door: Elena’s boots, with fresh mud and wet leaves stuck to the soles.
clues.proves: Elena went outside on the night of the murder; she did not remain in her bedroom.

clues.title: Guest register
clues.player_text: The register on the hall console: “Dr. I. Strat – Guest Room 2, arrived Nov. 14 at 18:00.”
clues.proves: The doctor is staying in Guest Room 2, indicating which key to find.

clues.title: Matei’s journal
clues.player_text: The victim’s journal, open on the desk. 18:00: “20,000 in the drawer, the workers’ wages.” 21:30: “V. left, slamming the door. Always money.” 21:50: “Strat came to take my pulse. Too insistent. I told him nothing. Monday.”
clues.proves: The doctor visited the victim after 21:30, contrary to his statement; Victor had already left.

clues.title: The blotter
clues.player_text: On the desk blotter, in a trembling hand: “the light is yellow… nausea… my heart is racing.”
clues.proves: These are symptoms of digitalis poisoning (yellow-tinted vision).

clues.title: Bottle on the desk
clues.player_text: The bottle on the desk: white stopper, almost full. Label: “Tincture of digitalis.”
clues.proves: The bottle on the desk is the proper one; the poison came from another bottle.

clues.title: Empty drawer
clues.player_text: The desk drawer is open and empty.
clues.proves: The money placed there at 18:00 has disappeared.

clues.title: The victim’s key ring
clues.player_text: On the arm of the chair, beside the victim’s pocket watch: his key ring.
clues.proves: It opens the master bedroom.

clues.title: The unwashed cup
clues.player_text: On the tray, the unwashed cup, with a note in Ana’s hand: “DO NOT wash – for the police gentlemen.”
clues.proves: Ana preserved the evidence; a culprit would have washed the cup.

clues.title: “Guest Room 2” key
clues.player_text: On the spare-key board, a key labeled “Guest Room 2.”
clues.proves: It opens the doctor’s room.

clues.title: The gardener’s notebook
clues.player_text: The gardener’s notebook, left on the windowsill: “Greenhouse lock: the year of the master and lady’s wedding, as the lady requested.”
clues.proves: The rule for the greenhouse combination.

clues.title: Ana’s calendar
clues.player_text: Ana’s calendar, Monday, November 17: “7:00 carriage – Mr. M. to the Prosecutor’s Office.”
clues.proves: Ana knew about the report, so she had been reading the master’s letters.

clues.title: Half-burned wrapper
clues.player_text: In the stove: a half-burned wrapper. “Black Eagle Pharmacy, Cluj – Pure digitoxin 1 g – Dr. I. Str…”
clues.proves: The doctor bought the poison.

clues.title: The accountant’s letter
clues.player_text: On the small desk: a letter from accountant Popescu. The hospital funds are short by 400,000 lei; every payment order is signed by Dr. Strat.
clues.proves: The doctor was stealing the hospital’s money.

clues.title: Draft will
clues.player_text: In the desk drawer: the draft of a new will. The factory – to Victor. 30,000 lei – to Ana. The manor – to Elena.
clues.proves: Everyone in the house stands to gain something from Matei’s death.

clues.title: Wedding photograph
clues.player_text: On the wall, Matei and Elena’s wedding photograph. On the back: “Sinaia, June 1919.”
clues.proves: The greenhouse combination: 1919.

clues.title: Prescription on the nightstand
clues.player_text: On the nightstand, a prescription: “Tincture of digitalis, 10 drops in the 22:00 tea. Dr. I. Strat.”
clues.proves: The doctor knew the victim’s dose, time, and habit.

clues.title: Black-stoppered bottle
clues.player_text: Hidden in the lining of the medical bag: an empty black-stoppered bottle with a bitter smell.
clues.proves: It is the bottle Ana saw at 22:00; the doctor had it in his possession.

clues.title: Bank demand notice
clues.player_text: In the suitcase: a demand notice from Someșul Bank. A 350,000-lei loan due on November 20, secured by a mortgage on the doctor’s house.
clues.proves: Why the doctor needed the hospital’s money.

clues.title: Pharmacology treatise
clues.player_text: A pharmacology treatise, its page folded at “Digitalis”: yellow-tinted vision, nausea, arrhythmia. “Rapid death only with purified digitoxin; foxglove leaves cause slow poisoning with vomiting.”
clues.proves: The poison came from a pharmacy, not the greenhouse (the coroner reported no vomiting).

clues.title: Corner of a letter
clues.player_text: In the small stove: an unburned corner of a letter from Matei to attorney Lazăr. “…on Monday I will hand the Prosecutor’s Office the file on Dr. S…”
clues.proves: The victim planned to report the doctor on Monday.

clues.title: Blooming foxglove
clues.player_text: Pots of blooming foxglove (Digitalis purpurea), labeled in Elena’s hand.
clues.proves: Elena had access to a plant from which the same poison is made.

clues.title: Letters from “R.”
clues.player_text: Hidden in an empty pot: letters signed “R.” The latest: “I will pass by the greenhouse window at 22:30. Shall we leave in December?”
clues.proves: Elena’s secret affair.

clues.title: Blanketed chair
clues.player_text: A chair with a blanket, an almost-spent oil lamp, and a half-finished glass of wine.
clues.proves: Elena spent hours in the greenhouse.

motive_options.text: He was stealing from the charity hospital and was about to be reported to the Prosecutor’s Office.
He wanted to inherit the factory and pay his gambling debts.
She wanted the 30,000 lei left to her in the new will.
She wanted to be free to leave with her lover without a scandal.

method_options.text: Pure digitoxin in a bottle identical to the heart drops, switched before tea and restored after death.
Poison placed directly in the tea in the kitchen before it was served.
Foxglove leaves from the greenhouse, boiled and mixed into the tea.
An excessive dose from the heart-drop bottle on the desk.

reveal:
Matei Vornicu was murdered by the doctor he trusted most. Dr. Ilie Strat had stolen 400,000 lei from the Charity Hospital funds to cover a Someșul Bank loan due on November 20. On November 12, Matei learned everything from the hospital accountant and wrote to his attorney that he would hand the file to the Prosecutor’s Office on Monday.

Strat had prepared: on November 10, he bought one gram of pure digitoxin in Cluj and poured it into a bottle identical to Matei’s heart-drop bottle, but with a black stopper. On the night of the murder, at 21:45, he entered the library “to take his pulse,” switched the bottles, and took the letter to the attorney from the desk, later burning it in his room. At 22:00, Matei put ten drops from the black-stoppered bottle into his tea himself. Ana noticed the stopper but suspected nothing.

At about 22:45, Matei began seeing everything with a yellow tint and could barely write a few words on the blotter. He died at about 23:00. When Ana found him, the doctor sent her for a blanket and, during the five minutes he was alone, restored the proper bottle. He threw the pharmacy wrapper into the kitchen stove, but it burned only halfway.

The others also had secrets. Victor had stolen the money from the drawer and lost it at cards, but he was at the inn at the time of death. Elena was waiting for her lover in the greenhouse. Ana was reading the master’s letters. But only one of them had the poison, the opportunity, and a motive that could not wait until Monday.
